dataRepo.heading: Data repository (Exit ①, read-only)
dataRepo.pathHintPrefix: The data repository path is a trusted server-side config, settable only at startup with
dataRepo.pathHintSuffix: ; it is never entered via the UI and never echoed over HTTP. To change it, restart the daemon with that flag.

providers.heading: Direct targets & keys
providers.disclosurePrefix: Built-in providers are fixed open-source model sources and cannot be edited. API keys are used only to authenticate outbound requests; after being written they are encrypted into the local user directory (
providers.disclosureSuffix: , AES-256-GCM), never echoed and never written to any receipt or log.

picker.heading: Select sessions to review
picker.emptyFolder: Select a folder on the left to view sessions.

tree.notRecommended: No public remote (not recommended for public): {{reason}}
tree.showAll: Show all projects (including those without a public remote)
tree.showAllHint: By default, only projects with a public git remote are shown (recommended). Private / unpushed projects stay hidden until you explicitly opt in.

disposition.clearedMessage: All findings in this session have been triaged.
disposition.cleanAllTitle: {{count}} findings in this session can be auto-replaced by rule
disposition.cleanAllHint: Secret / custom findings will be replaced with stable aliases; engine downgrades and image attachments still need your manual confirmation.

exit.oneDescription: Contribute the redacted session as a PR to the public data repository: precheck → PR preview → submit. The preferred channel for maximum open value.
exit.twoDescription: Send the session directly to your chosen model provider for replay evaluation. Includes a cost estimate and double informed confirmation.
exit.guidanceNeedsConfig: No data repository configured. Publishing becomes available after you restart the daemon with `--data-repo <path>` (the path is server-side config only, never entered via the UI).
exit.guidanceMissingDeps: Missing git, or the data repository working tree is dirty. Install git, then commit or clean the working tree and retry.
exit.guidanceGhUnauth: gh is installed but not signed in. You can continue on the manual path (stage + manually push to open a PR), or run `gh auth login` first to enable one-click submit.

batchExit.oneDescription: Merge {{count}} redacted sessions into a single branch / single PR contributed to the public data repository: precheck → PR preview → submit.
batchExit.twoTitle: Batch Exit ②　API direct send
batchExit.twoDescription: Send {{count}} sessions one by one to your chosen model provider, with a total cost estimate and per-session content-bound informed confirmation.
